verdict.rationale: Unstructured documents OCR-related capabilities. Pages are auto-routed to High Res or VLM partitioning based on quality needs, and a generative OCR enrichment uses a VLM to improve the fidelity of extracted text blocks. That covers the core of OCR on difficult documents, but the evidence never addresses the story's specific hard cases. Missing for 10: explicit support for scanned or photographed input, handling of skewed pages, stamps, and low-quality scans, accuracy benchmarks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
